# discord_member_roles (Resource)

Manages role assignments for a Discord server member.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) The server (guild) ID.
- `user_id` (String) The user ID of the member.

### Optional

- `role` (Block Set) Role to assign to the member. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--role))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite ID in the format `server_id:user_id`.

<a id="nestedblock--role"></a>
### Nested Schema for `role`

Required:

- `role_id` (String) The ID of the role to assign.
